ValidationRule.description: Qantas Host Always Call can only be ticked if Contact tier is Chairman's Lounge or CLPO. But System Administrator can tick any tier.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - Freight", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - QCC", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - SND", ISCHANGED(QCC_Qantas_Host_Always_Call__c), QCC_Qantas_Host_Always_Call__c, OR( TEXT(Frequent_Flyer_Tier__c) <> "Chairman's Lounge", TEXT(Frequent_Flyer_Tier__c) <> "Chairman's Lounge Platinum One"
) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Contact must be Chairman's Lounge Platinum One or Chairman's Lounge to receive this service.
